common_random_numbers: Same latent opportunity pools, project-choice shocks, and evaluation RNG seeds across systems and scenarios within each world/generation.
expert_budget: Equal total expert-action budget per generation; formal peer review consumes part of the peer-review budget.
interpretive_boundary: Finance, government, fame, entropy, and attribution-capture strengths are structural sweeps, not empirical estimates. Attribution capture models unattributed or prestige-shifted rediscovery, not an empirical claim of deliberate theft.
